answer_1.quote: We carry out a multifaceted evaluation that includes automatic and extensive manual analyses on three language pairs (en-es, en-fr, en-it) ... We experiment with three end-to-end ST solutions, namely: LARGE-BPE, SMALL-BPE, and SMALL-CHAR ...

answer_2.quote: In terms of BLEU score -34.12 on en-es, 40.3 on en-fr, 27.7 on en-it -our LARGE-BPE models compare favorably ... We also compute gender accuracy as the proportion of words generated in the correct gender among the measurable ones.

answer_4.quote: We manually inspect CHAR and BPE system's output on the out-of-coverage (OOC) words ... performed via a systematic annotation of systems' outputs, performed by the same linguists that enriched MuST-SHE ...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators classified OOC words into translation errors, adequate alternatives with correct gender, wrong gender, or neutral expressions, and assessed gender agreement in chains.
